title: esc_deselect_chord's placing==-1 assert is vacuous (placement never armed on leg 1)
location: harness/parity.odin:986-989 (check_states merged arm) + scenario 21 frames at harness/parity.odin:713-718
evidence: check_states: "case \"input_parity_esc_deselect_chord\", \"input_parity_esc_cancel_chord\": ... if r, ok := find(runs, devs, .Mouse); ok && r.placing != -1 { append(fails, fmt.tprintf(...)) }" — scenario 21 frames: "evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .Esc}, inp.Mouse_Press{pos = n1, button = .Right}, inp.Mouse_Press{pos = n1, button = .Left}), evs(inp.Mouse_Release{pos = n1, button = .Left})," (no Arm_Placement frame) — drive_parity: "ictx.placing = -1".
detail: On the esc_deselect_chord leg the placing assert cannot fail: nothing arms placement, so placing is -1 from init (drive_parity sets ictx.placing = -1) through every frame. Only the sel_node==1 probe pins leg 1; the placing check is meaningful solely for leg 2.
recommended_fix: Gate the placing assert on the cancel leg only (sc.name == "input_parity_esc_cancel_chord"), or arm placement in the deselect-leg script so the assert can bite there too.

title: Shared popover_demolish_hit's positive button path (incl. the new pipe leg) is unexercised by any scenario
evidence: parity_ui_press_effect: "return inp.popover_demolish_hit(ictx, pos)" — wired only for esc_ui: "ui_hook: proc(rawptr, ^inp.Input, rl.Vector2) -> bool = nil; if sc.name == \"input_parity_esc_ui\" { ui_hook = parity_ui_press_effect }" — and esc_ui's press runs after the map-time deselect ("if esc_deselect { inp.sel_pipe = -1; inp.sel_node = -1 }"), so sel is always -1 at hook time. popover_demolish_hit's pipe leg: "if inp.sel_pipe >= 0 { ps, ok := pp.pipe_slot(inp.topo, u32(inp.sel_pipe)) ..." — no scenario presses with a pipe selected.
detail: The delta moved the demolish-button hit-test into the shared function and gave the harness stub a pipe leg, but every scripted press sees sel cleared (esc_ui) — a broken button rect or pipe-anchor math would leave all 22 scenarios green. The stub's pipe leg is unreachable dead weight today.
recommended_fix: Add a positive-pin scenario: select the pipe (or junction), press the demolish button center, assert the Demolish command + swallow (demolish_button_rect hit) — the app-popover twin of the X-key pin.
